headline: Tony Bloom on Hurzeler and Brighton’s future: ‘We have a realistic chance of finishing in the top five’
body: “We’ve got a great squad and the biggest depth we’ve ever had. We don’t have ceilings, so we can finish high in the Premier League. Absolutely, we have a realistic chance of finishing in the top five.” Brighton chairman and owner Tony Bloom on: 🔵 Why he hired Fabian Hurzeler and whether he fears losing him to bigger fish 🔵 The decision to break the club’s transfer record this summer with the £46m signing of Luka Vuskovic 🔵 Why he rarely buys English players 🔵 His verdict on whether there is a ceiling to what Brighton can achieve   submitted by   /u/TheAthletic [link]   [comments]
